title: Improve Request Port Extraction in ServeCommand
desc: Patched port handling in ServeCommand.php to prevent Artisan command failures when the port string is non-trivial.

title: beforeCommit() honors ShouldQueueAfterCommit
desc: The method beforeCommit() now executes correctly even when the job uses the ShouldQueueAfterCommit contract, thus closing the gap between transactional intent and queue lifecycle.

title: Fix security vulnerability in previousPath() method
desc: Reported and patched a security vulnerability where previousPath() could leak external URLs back to the caller. Fix discussed; ultimately superseded.

title: Boost: queue-job retryUntil() type
desc: Corrected return-type in queue-job guidelines so Boost's static suggestions match the framework's actual contract.

title: Prevent saving default models without keys
desc: Model instances created via withDefault() were being saved without valid foreign keys set, when using the automaticallyEagerLoadRelationships(). Proposed fix, later the automaticallyEagerLoading feature itself was deprecated due to its drawbacks.

title: Contributed in Laravel Request Analytics
desc: Several PRs got merged here, which contained some feature work and fixes for the request analytics package.
